author: skyzhishui
description: 基于 vLLM-Omni（/v1/audio/speech）的语音合成插件：LLM 以 <vllm_tts> 标签直接发语音，支持流式/非流式、采样率选择（Qwen3-TTS 24kHz / VoxCPM2 48kHz）、内联情绪指令（可选）与声音克隆（可选）

en.description: Text-to-speech for vLLM-Omni (/v1/audio/speech): the LLM sends voice via a <vllm_tts> tag. Supports streaming/non-streaming synthesis, configurable sample rate (Qwen3-TTS 24kHz / VoxCPM2 48kHz), optional inline emotion control and optional voice cloning.
